lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَبُسَّتِ is in the derivative form: بُسَّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/س/س   b–s–s to scatter; to travel throughout the land; to crumble; to drive gently; to stroke with the hand, to mix together.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
بُسَّ bussa and بَسٌّ bass.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بُسَّ bussa [pass. v.; v. n. بَسٌّ bass] to be crumbled, to be crushed, to be ground

(56:5) وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا and the mountains are ground to powder.
